      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a member: release notes and BIP references simply follow the P2P feature implementation."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch mempool data structures, limits, or transaction policy.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a member: stale tip relay operates on block headers and stale forks, not mempool transactions."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches a functional mining test file mechanically to accommodate stale tip relay behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a member: does not modify block template construction or miner interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the P2P label, adds stale tip message protocol types and processing in net_processing, handles BIP 434 feature negotiation, and adjusts P2P DoS rules.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Implements the BIP 332 stale tip relay protocol to inform nodes of reorgs and stale branches across the network. The PR introduces substantial protocol functionality, message handling, and adjustments to peer disconnection rules for unvalidated stale branch blocks."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/net.cpp and src/rpc/blockchain.cpp only to surface BIP 434 and stale tip information.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Not a member: RPC edits merely expose underlying P2P feature state and do not change RPC infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds extensive unit, fuzz, and functional tests that specifically exercise the new stale tip relay logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Not a member: tests are domain-specific coverage for BIP 332 message handling rather than general test harness infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp and peerman_args only to plumb configuration flags (-staletips).",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a member: argument plumbing is routine integration of a P2P feature."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp and src/validationinterface.cpp to provide stale tip signals to node components.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a member: hook plumbing through ValidationInterface does not substantively alter consensus rules, chainstate management, or validation invariants."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,

    "leverage": 1
  }
}
